It was great to meet students and teachers from Ely High School this week — especially meaningful because that’s where my dad went to high school.

Can’t wait to see what these rising leaders achieve in the years to come.

elyecho.com/article/4329,ely…

At Bushmills Ethanol in Atwater to highlight the need to increase biofuels in our fuel supply. With the administration’s war with Iran driving up gas prices, I’ll keep pushing for year-round E15 to lower prices at the pump and support Minnesota farmers.

Video

We start the day w/this  Washington Post headline:

Gas hits $4 a gallon for the first time in nearly four years

This didn’t need to happen. Self-inflicted wound on our country and most of the world by this administration. Unilateral actions without an endgame have consequences.

I was at the Minnesota Poultry Testing Laboratory in Willmar with the Minnesota Turkey Growers Association talking about the importance of disease prevention. This lab plays a critical role in supporting Minnesota farmers and keeping our food supply safe.

I visited with workers at the 3M manufacturing plant in Hutchinson, where products like scotch tape are shipped everywhere. Thanks to CEO Bill Brown and plant manager Susie Nelson for showing me around.

Investing in manufacturing and our workforce supports good jobs and helps Minnesota companies compete globally.

They want to take away people’s health care to pay for their war in Iran while gas prices are spiraling as a result? That is just upside down for what Americans need right now.


Axios (@axios)

NEW: Republicans are considering reductions in federal health spending to help pay for a budget bill containing as much as $200 billion to fund the Iran war and immigration enforcement. axios.com/2026/03/30/gop-hea…

DFLers were fired up and ready to get to work in Burnsville at the Senate District 55 convention! Coming together for our neighbors and a better future for all of Minnesota.

Thank you, Coach Phil!

As the leader of USA Curling, you’ve brought our whole state and country together and given us so much pride. Great to have you on the team!

Video
We celebrated Mayor Kaohly Her’s historic election as St. Paul’s first woman and first Hmong-American mayor. Looking forward to partnering with the new mayor to keep St. Paul moving forward.

That’s called a rally! Minnesota showed up.

Video

Tens of thousands filled the Capitol Mall in St. Paul with a clear message:

NO KINGS.

In America, liberties matter and power belongs to the people.

Video

The sun is shining on Minnesota today! NO KINGS


The Minnesota Star Tribune (@StarTribune)

Minnesota State Patrol officials estimate more than 50,000 people have arrived at the Capitol for the #NoKings rally. Follow live updates here: bit.ly/4dOESt2

📸: Kyeland Jackson

Video

Today, people across the country are marching for our democracy, saying NO KINGS in the United States! This morning I joined frontline Indivisible members in St. Louis Park. Many of us are now on our way to St. Paul!

Started the day in Roseville with the plumbers of Local 34 & 15, who are volunteering their time to help families in need. Their skill & generosity make a real difference. Thanks to AFL-CIO Pres. Liz Shuler & MN AFL Pres. Bernie Burnham for joining us.

Huge crowd at the Ukrainian American Community Center’s Lenten Friday Fish Fry and took this photo from the stage. Always inspired by the strength of Minnesota’s Ukrainian community. I’m proud to stand with them and with Ukraine. 🇺🇸🇺🇦
Sweet 16 tonight in Sacramento. Let’s go Gophers! 〽️ 🏀

I toured Plaza Del Sol today with Carlos Lopez and Alma Flores from the Latino Economic Development Center. Minnesota's small businesses and neighborhoods have been through a lot, and I'm looking forward to seeing this space open up and bring new opportunities to St. Paul!

Video

The DOJ’s weak Live Nation settlement showed why we need stronger antitrust enforcement.

I’ve introduced legislation to ensure antitrust settlements are fully reviewed and actually protect consumers.
